about: Release protections the Factory applies with build/protect.mjs (workflow 'Protect release branches'). Dinis, 2026-11-20: try on live and a couple of other PrompTugal repositories first; 'the key requirement is that (for now) the agent that creates the PR can still merge it'. So pull requests require no approving review. stage 'base': no force-push or deletion of dev, release tags v* creatable only by GitHub Actions, Pages deploys from dev only; nothing changes how agents work. stage 'pr': base plus a pull request required for every change to dev, with the listed checks passing. Move a repository to 'pr' only after its workflow runs those checks on pull requests and its agents work through pull requests.
